title: The Final 24 Hours of my World Cup | Erling Haaland Vlog
description:
The World Cup was unforgettable. Join me for my final week of the tournament with special guest Zlatan Ibrahimović, an unforgettable visit home to meet the Royal Family, and a celebration with the incredible people of Norway. 🇳🇴❤️
